body.message:
I found red bed bugs in the apartment, and my children are having a very serious reaction. My son’s eye has become severely irritated, and he has been unable to sleep because of the itching and discomfort. This is a serious health and safety issue for my children.

Is it acceptable under your accommodation policy to have guests staying in a place with a bed bug infestation, especially when children are being affected? I expect this issue to be addressed immediately and appropriate action to be taken.
